channel.title: The AI Glittch by Youssef Jalloul
channel.description: Sarcasm, sources and the occasional rogue toaster. Enterprise AI, private AI and governance.

item.title: Is ChatGPT Safe for Company Data? Ask the Toaster.
item.description: Short answer: it depends on the tier, the settings and what your people paste. Here is what has actually gone wrong, what the enterprise plans change, and a 7-point checklist before anyone pastes the board pack.

item.title: What Is Private AI, and Does Your Company Actually Need It?
item.description: Private AI means the models, data and logs run somewhere you control: your servers, an in-country cloud, or a locked-down private tenant. Here is when you need it, when you don't, and the four ways to get there.

item.title: How Do I Stop Employees Pasting Confidential Data Into AI Tools?
item.description: You don't stop it with a ban. You stop it by giving people something better than the toaster, then governing it. Seven moves that cut shadow AI without killing productivity.

item.title: Saudi Is Building a Giant Brain in the Desert and Charging Admission
item.description: Money, power and sovereignty: how Saudi Arabia is manufacturing an AI ecosystem rather than importing one, and what enterprises should do about it.

item.title: The New Disorder: AI-Induced Laziness Syndrome
item.description: AI writes the report, AI summarises it, AI turns it into five bullets. Nobody reads a thing. The three ways to use AI without becoming intellectually obese.

item.title: Me, Myself & AI: Why Enterprise Automation Needs More Than Digital Duct Tape
item.description: Why sector-specific, secure AI agents beat duct-taped workflows, and the three laws of real enterprise AI learned while customising BLDR.

item.title: LLM Hypnosis: Did Your ChatGPT Just Get Brainwashed?
item.description: Researchers showed that coordinated thumbs-up feedback can nudge a model’s behaviour for everyone. Why that matters for enterprise AI, and what to ask your vendors.

item.title: The 10 Commandments of Writing Like a Human
item.description: So your posts don’t sound like they were written by your toaster. Ten rules for using AI to write without sounding like a user manual.

item.title: Microsoft Copilot Just Leaked Your Secrets to a Toaster
item.description: EchoLeak: a zero-click flaw that could make Microsoft 365 Copilot leak sensitive data from a single crafted email. A satirical PR pitch for the scandal you want to avoid.

item.title: MIT Says ChatGPT Is Making Us Dumber. Are We All Just Copy+Paste Zombies Now?
item.description: MIT’s “Your Brain on ChatGPT” study found the brain-only group out-thought the AI group. Cognitive debt, creativity and how not to become a copy-paste zombie.

item.title: “SEO Is Dead!” Long Live AEO
item.description: If you’re not optimising to be the answer, you’re invisible. Why Answer Engine Optimization matters more than SEO now, and how to win at it.

item.title: AI Billions in Play in the GCC: Where’s the Money Going?
item.description: Saudi, the UAE and Qatar are pouring billions into AI. Most of it is going into infrastructure, not free ChatGPT for your grandma. Five commandments for winning the GCC AI game.
